result.query: SELECT json_build_object('vpcs',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',vpc_id,'state',state,'reason',reason)) FROM network_vpcs WHERE state<>'deleted'),'subnets',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_subnets WHERE state<>'deleted'),'eips',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',eip_id,'state',state,'reason',reason)) FROM network_eips WHERE state<>'deleted'),'snats',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_snat_bindings WHERE state<>'deleted'),'platform',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',resource_id,'kind',kind,'state',state,'reason',reason)) FROM network_platform_resources WHERE state<>'deleted'));
